claude-opus-5-5.note: A recognisable, cute alpaca with upright ears, long neck and fluffy fleece, but the legs are stiff unjointed sticks swinging like pendulums under a cloud-blob body with an odd belly smudge, set in a soft, pleasant but generic meadow whose scrolling grass sells the walk better than the gait itself.

openai-gpt-6-sol.note: The fluffy, long-necked animal reads as an alpaca, but its stiff legs and nearly stationary body make the walk feel mechanical; the soft meadow is pleasant but simple.
